first_draft_path_after.baseline: _submission_baseline: one bounded GET of get_student_revision_candidates before the POST; newest server submitted_at of same-mode rows
first_draft_path_after.guard: consume_pending('writing', mode, lang) before building the submission; enter_pending('writing') before the POST; release on success/ordinary error; outcome stored + held until consumed on timeout
first_draft_path_after.mode: FIRST_DRAFT when revision_of_submission_id is None else LINKED_REVISION
first_draft_path_after.no_retry_ui: REQUEST_TIMEOUT never reaches render_api_error; no Retry button on ambiguous timeouts
first_draft_path_after.reconciliation: _reconcile_writing_submission: same-mode rows with submitted_at > baseline, exactly one, submission bundle with student + exact essay text equality; feedback present -> CONFIRMED_SUCCESS, else STILL_PROCESSING; zero/multiple/read-failure/mismatch -> UNCONFIRMED
first_draft_path_after.timeout_messages: student_writing_submit_pending / student_writing_timeout_confirmed_success / student_writing_timeout_still_processing / student_writing_timeout_unconfirmed (mode-dependent; revision-mode reuses student_revision_* keys)

linked_revision_path_after.baseline: render-time server submitted_at baseline for the source (unchanged v0.9.6-A)
linked_revision_path_after.guard: consume_pending('revision', 'LINKED_REVISION', lang); enter_pending('revision') before the POST; identical session keys as v0.9.6-A (revision_submit_pending / revision_submit_outcome)

public_entries.submit: delegates to _submit_long_running; used by the Writing page for first drafts AND writing-page revisions
public_entries.submit_linked_revision: delegates to _submit_long_running; used by the Revision page

shared_client_transport.retry: no automatic POST retry (retry applies only to GET)

shared_ui_helper.responsibilities: pending-state entry/release, queued-click consumption, outcome storage/rendering, per-mode message mapping
